turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
Hale. I have a call at 4:40, so you have twenty minutes. My son found out about a zero on his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me, so start with who decided that.
Before we go on, I'm recording this meeting.
Fine. I'll want a copy of the recording. Now, who decided?
And if you so much as mention legal action, I'm filing a harassment complaint through the union.

I haven't said a word about legal action, and you're recording, so the record will show that. I asked who decided, and before or after anyone heard Owen. Answer it, or I walk down to the principal's office now.
"Carefully." I'm writing that down. Who decided, Hale?
